title: D-085 Opus 5.5 loop-worker pin: the auto-mode classifier blocks the agent's model_selection.toml edits (capture + authorized retry-once both denied), and the shared allowlist additionally needs claude-opus-5-5 added - both are owner edits
affects: D-085-R004 (loop worker pins to claude-opus-5-5 x-high)
D-085-R005 (main-orchestrator restart handoff - unaffected in content, waits only on its own seam)
detail: Executing D-085-R004 (owner-authorized, source-002 amendment captured and validator-PASS): CLI updated 2.1.252 -> 2.1.281 (R002 DONE, stale broken npm-global 2.1.220 removed on the updater's own recommendation); model id VERIFIED tool-side (R003 DONE): the 2.1.281 bundle carries claude-opus-5-5 (+ alias opus55) and a canary probe launched it live - modelUsage canonicalModel = claude-opus-5-5, context 1,000,000; the spelling 'opus-5.5' is NOT recognized (unrecognized_model, silent fallback to claude-opus-4-8 - never use the dotted form). The pin flip then hit the same guard class as the prior worker-pin arc: the auto-mode classifier denied the Edit of C:\SupervisorController\model_selection.toml twice (initial + the D-085-cited retry-once); per D-085-R004 and the no-hammering rule the agent stopped. Files verified UNMODIFIED. ADDITIONALLY the shared immutable allowlist C:\Program Files\SupervisorConfig\config.toml (all three lanes point at it) lists only claude-fable-5 and claude-opus-4-8 in [claude].allowed_models and [approved_models].models - claude-opus-5-5 must be added there or the launch refuses the pin; that file also sits under Program Files (admin write). Lanes are all idle, so no live run is at risk; nothing else in the program waits on this.
needs: OWNER ACTION - four small edits, then tell the orchestrator. (1)-(3) In each of C:\SupervisorController\model_selection.toml, C:\SupervisorController2\model_selection.toml, C:\SupervisorController3\model_selection.toml change line 39 from  model = "claude-opus-4-8"  to  model = "claude-opus-5-5"  and save (no effort key needed - xhigh already binds at the session layer per D-004-R159; effortLevel xhigh confirmed in each lane's .claude/settings.json). (4) In C:\Program Files\SupervisorConfig\config.toml (open the editor As Administrator) add "claude-opus-5-5" to BOTH lists: line 21 [claude] allowed_models and line 23 [approved_models] models, e.g. allowed_models = ["claude-fable-5", "claude-opus-4-8", "claude-opus-5-5"]. AUTHORIZATION ALREADY RECORDED: D-085-R004 (this blocker is its classifier-block return path). No launch probe needed for an initial pin (B-024 finding). Alternative: the owner may instead add a Claude Code permission rule allowing the agent to edit these specific files and tell the orchestrator to redo the edits itself.
workaround_in_effect: None needed: all three loop lanes are idle at natural closes (no packet is waiting on a loop dispatch right now); the in-flight review waves are orchestrator-side and unaffected. The pins stay on claude-opus-4-8 until the owner edits.
history_note: Same guard class as the resolved B-024 arc (worker-pin flip = owner-only under controller S3.2 rule 6 + classifier-blocked for the agent). This instance differs in direction (upgrade trial to a NEW model, not exhaustion recovery) and adds the allowlist step because claude-opus-5-5 was never allowlisted before.
